body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2). `packages/gate-manifest/test/forest-format.test.mjs` and `gate-manifest.test.mjs` contain 83 `try/finally` blocks and redundant local `makeTmp()` / `cleanTmp()` helpers that manually clean up tempdirs. Following the introduction of `@adlc/core/test-kit` in #1098, both files can adopt `tmp(t)` with automatic `t.after` lifecycle cleanup, and both files can be removed from `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` ALLOWLIST.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/gate-manifest/test/forest-format.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test cases to accept `t` parameter and use `tmp(t, 'gate-manifest-forest-test-')`.
   - Remove local `cleanTmp` and `makeTmp`.
   - Remove all 43 `try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In `packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test cases to accept `t` parameter and use `tmp(t, 'gate-manifest-test-')`.
   - Remove local `cleanTmp` and `makeTmp`.
   - Remove all 40 `try { ... } finally { cleanTmp(dir); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/gate-manifest/test/forest-format.test.mjs'` and `'packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs'` from the ALLOWLIST array.
4. Ensure all gate-manifest and boundary tests pass: `npm test -w packages/gate-manifest` and `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/gate-manifest/test/forest-format.test.mjs packages/gate-manifest/test/gate-manifest.test.mjs` reports 1 and 1 (only the `withKey` scoping try/finally blocks remain; all 83 fixture cleanup finally blocks are gone).
- AC2 Neither file defines local `function cleanTmp` or local `function makeTmp`.
- AC3 `grep -E -n '(forest-format\.test\.mjs|gate-manifest\.test\.mjs)' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/gate-manifest` exits 0 with all test cases passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(gate-manifest): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 83 try/finally blocks in forest-format and gate-manifest tests
